```yaml
name: Test
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "develop" ]
    tags: [ "*" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "develop" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.26.x]
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        cache: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        go mod tidy
        go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest

    - name: Run go fix
      run: |
        go fix ./...
        go mod tidy

    - name: Run linters
      run: |
        golangci-lint run --timeout=5m

    - name: Run tests with race detector on main/develop/tags
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
      run: |
        go test -v -race ./...

    - name: Run tests without race detector on PRs
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: |
        go test -v ./...

    - name: Check for go fix drift
      run: |
        git diff --exit-code || (echo "go fix introduced changes - please run 'go fix ./...' locally" && exit 1)

  sqlite-migration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.26.x]
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        cache: true

    - name: Run SQLite migration parity checks
      run: |
        go test -v -run TestSQLiteMigrationParity ./...

  postgres-migration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.26.x]
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        cache: true

    - name: Run Postgres migration parity checks
      run: |
        go test -v -run TestPostgresMigrationParity ./...

  precommit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: [1.26.x]
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        cache: true

    - name: Run precommit checks
      run: |
        make precommit
```
